meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以操控浏览器:打开网址、点击元素、填写表单、滚动页面、上传文件、截图、录制视频、读取网页文字和状态等。它会用快照获取页面元素,再按引用操作。
howto.when: 当用户需要浏览网页、填写表单、截图等网页操作,或要求自动化完成类似的浏览器任务时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图保存为首页.png
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器访问该网址并截图。

say.text: 在这个登录页帮我填写测试账号并提交
say.note: Claude 会读取页面元素,填入内容并点击提交。

say.text: 提取当前页面所有商品标题和价格
say.note: Claude 会读取网页内容并整理成列表返回。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a real browser: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, scroll, upload files, take screenshots, record videos, and read page text or state. It uses snapshots to find elements and operate by reference.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to open web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, or perform similar browser tasks, such as testing web apps or extracting page data.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a screenshot as homepage.png
say_en.note: Claude will launch a browser, visit the URL, and take a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill in the test account on this login page and submit
say_en.note: Claude will read the page elements, fill the fields, and click submit.

say_en.text: Extract all product titles and prices from this page
say_en.note: Claude will read the page content and return a structured list.
